primary.title: Notes on the State of Virginia
primary.author: Thomas Jefferson
primary.rationale: Jefferson's most famous work, offering a comprehensive view of his thoughts on government, society, natural history, and slavery.

primary.title: The Declaration of Independence
primary.author: Thomas Jefferson
primary.rationale: The foundational document of American independence, primarily authored by Jefferson.

primary.title: The Papers of Thomas Jefferson
primary.author: Thomas Jefferson
primary.rationale: A vast collection of Jefferson's correspondence, writings, and notes, providing unparalleled insight into his life and thought. Many volumes are digitized.

secondary.title: Thomas Jefferson: The Art of Power
secondary.author: Jon Meacham
secondary.rationale: A highly acclaimed and comprehensive biography that explores Jefferson's political strategies and intellectual development.

secondary.title: American Sphinx: The Character of Thomas Jefferson
secondary.author: Joseph J. Ellis
secondary.rationale: A Pulitzer Prize-winning biography that delves into the complexities and contradictions of Jefferson's character and legacy.

secondary.title: The Cambridge Companion to Thomas Jefferson
secondary.author: A. J. Smith
secondary.rationale: A collection of essays by leading scholars covering various aspects of Jefferson's life, work, and influence.

suggestions.notes: The 'Papers of Thomas Jefferson' is a multi-volume collection, and the year 1760 marks the beginning of its coverage. Specific volumes may have later publication dates. The primary source 'The Declaration of Independence' is often found within collections of Jefferson's writings or historical documents.
